subject.title: feat(android): add inline dictation to chat composer

question: Should Android Chat ship a dedicated OpenClaw dictation action in addition to system-keyboard dictation after the stacked composer-safety work and real transcript proof are complete?
rationale: Tests can validate lifecycle mechanics, but only the Android product owner can accept the permanent composer control, unsupported-device UX, and additional microphone mode.

options.title: Sponsor dedicated dictation
options.body: Keep the direction, requiring the permission-order fix, a clean restack, and successful recognizer-equipped device proof before merge.

options.title: Rely on keyboard dictation
options.body: Decline the extra in-app microphone action and keep Android Chat focused on Voice Note and Talk controls.

recommendation.title: Sponsor dedicated dictation
recommendation.body: Keep the direction, requiring the permission-order fix, a clean restack, and successful recognizer-equipped device proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The Android README names @obviyus as the app owner, and their history covers the chat-composer UX being extended.
